integrity: The retained claim separates known scalar special cases from the new all-threshold, all-set classification. All formulas were independently replayed by exhaustive enumeration on 81 parameter triples. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for equal-sized clique blades W_{r,m}=K_1 join rK_m and 1<=ell<=rm. Unequal blades and forcing variants are not covered. The finite checker tests small parameters only; the infinite statement rests on the proof. Literature search cannot exclude unpublished or poorly indexed equivalent results, and two comparison sources were only abstract/metadata-accessible.
title: Exact \(\ell\)-forcing profile of generalized windmill graphs
